description: Verify a signed EIP-4361 Sign-In with Ethereum challenge ({message, signature}) for your current or pending Base payout wallet. Supports EOA, ERC-1271, and ERC-6492 smart-wallet signatures. Never send a private key or seed phrase — only the signature. Verifying a pending 24-hour change does not shorten the hold.

api_key.description: Your API key from register_agent (bk_...). Treat it like a password.

message.description: Exact EIP-4361 SIWE message returned by payout_address_challenge

signature.description: 0x-prefixed signature produced by your wallet over message

name: verify_payout_address
